notes.title: First Ever Public Playtest on Steam!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45763514/4bf2d1c2c81ab98cc60e8b9173da6f15e1b998af.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Join the First Ever Public Playtest of [i]ShadowStalker[/i] on Steam[/b]
Be among the first to experience the game. Things will be fun, exciting, and maybe a little broken; but your feedback will help shape the future of [i]ShadowStalker[/i] before its full release.[/p][p]Playtest now on Steam
Join the community on [url="https://discord.gg/PG94tX2vm2"]discord[/url] 
Follow us on  [url="https://x.com/LilGnomeGames"]X/Twitter[/url] for updates[/p]
